info.title: BC Route Planner REST API
info.description:
**The BC Route Planner is currently only available for use by B.C. Government Ministries.** Finds shortest/fastest route between a start point and one or more stop points on British Columbia's public road network. The BC Route planner [webpage](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=9D99E684CCD042CD88FADC51E079B4B5) provides additional information. Here are some geocoded addresses to play with: 18 Douglas St,Victoria -123.36962,48.40892
1002 Johnson St, Victoria -123.355745,48.426206
543 Johnson St, Victoria, BC -123.36907,48.42770
14 Centennial Sq, Victoria, BC -123.36564,48.42863
1105 Royal Ave,New Westminster -122.92009,49.20063
808 Jackson Cres, New Westminster -122.90762,49.22558
10810 McDonald Rd, Chilliwack -121.93808,49.19859
3950 June Springs Rd, Kelowna -119.40751,49.83960
1201 Riondel Rd, Kootenay Bay -116.85402,49.74448
1201 Riondel Rd, Kootenay Bay -116.832759,49.730500 (parcelPoint)
2499 Walbran Pl, Courtenay -124.97295,49.71518
2013 Smoke Bluff Rd, Squamish -123.13946,49.70401
235 Kelvin Grove Way, Lions Bay -123.23524,49.45035 Please see our data collection notice. Please note that you may experience issues when submitting requests to the delivery or test environment if using this [OpenAPI specification](https://github.com/bcgov/api-specs) in other API console viewers. [API keys](https://api.gov.bc.ca/devportal/api-directory/740) are unique and can be acquired with a GitHub or IDIR account.

get.description: Returns the geometry of the shortest or fastest route between the given points, along with its length and duration. The vehicle type can optionally be specified in the path.

parameters.name: outputSRS
parameters.description: The EPSG code of the spatial reference system (SRS) to use for output geometries.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: If provided, the JSON result will be wrapped in a function call of the given name (for JSONP support).

parameters.name: asAttachment
parameters.description: If true, the result is returned as a file attachment.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.description: The routing criteria to use when determining the route. Default is fastest.

parameters.name: distanceUnit
parameters.description: The unit of measure for distances in the response. Default is km.

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: The coordinate (x,y) of the single point for the spatial request, in the format "x,y". Must be in the same SRS as the outputSRS parameter.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: The coordinates (x,y) of the points to route between, in the format "x,y,x,y...". Must be in the same SRS as the outputSRS parameter.

parameters.name: fromPoints
parameters.description: The coordinates (x,y) of the from points for betweenPairs requests, in the format "x,y,x,y...". Must be in the same SRS as the outputSRS parameter.

parameters.name: toPoints
parameters.description: The coordinates (x,y) of the to points for betweenPairs requests, in the format "x,y,x,y...". Must be in the same SRS as the outputSRS parameter.

parameters.name: departure
parameters.description: The date and time of departure, used to evaluate time-dependent routing constraints such as turn restrictions and ferry schedules.

parameters.name: correctSide
parameters.description: If true, the route will arrive on the correct side of the road.

parameters.name: vehicleType
parameters.description: The type of vehicle to route for.

parameters.name: followTruckRoute
parameters.description: If true, the route will follow designated truck routes where possible.

parameters.name: truckRouteMultiplier
parameters.description: A multiplier applied to the cost of non-truck-route segments when following truck routes.

parameters.name: routeDescription
parameters.description: A description of the request, echoed back in the response.

parameters.name: maxPairs
parameters.description: The maximum number of toPoints to evaluate for each fromPoint in betweenPairs requests.

parameters.name: roundTrip
parameters.description: If true, the route returns to its starting point.

parameters.name: zoneCount
parameters.description: The number of zones/contours to generate for isochrone requests, between 1 and 10.

parameters.name: zoneSize
parameters.description: The size of each zone/contour, in minutes for time-based isochrones or metres for distance-based isochrones.

parameters.name: inbound
parameters.description: If true, the isochrone/loop is computed inbound to the point rather than outbound.

parameters.name: enable
parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of modules to enable. Enable takes precedence over disable.

When the enable parameter is used, unlisted values will be disabled.

Module names include:
sc - ferry schedules; disabled by default and only suitable for demos
tf - historic traffic congestion; disabled by default and only suitable for demos
ev - road events; disabled by default and only suitable for demos
td - time-dependency; disabled by default; disabling this disables sc, tf, and ev modules
tr - turn restrictions; enabled by default; if td is disabled, time-dependent turn restrictions are ignored
tc - turn costs (e.g., left turns take longer than right turns); enabled by default
xc - crossing costs (e.g., crossing a major road takes longer than the other way around); enabled by default
gdf - global distortion field; applies friction factors by ITN road class; enabled by default
tl - transportation line IDs; disabled by default

parameters.name: disable
parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of modules to disable. Enable takes precedence over disable.

When the disable parameter is used, unlisted values will be enabled. (e.g., sc,tf,ev,td).
Module names include:
sc - ferry schedules; disabled by default and only suitable for demos
tf - historic traffic congestion; disabled by default and only suitable for demos
ev - road events; disabled by default and only suitable for demos
td - time-dependency; disabled by default; disabling this disables sc, tf, and ev modules
tr - turn restrictions; enabled by default; if td is disabled, time-dependent turn restrictions are ignored
tc - turn costs; enabled by default
xc - crossing costs; enabled by default
gdf - global distortion field; enabled by default
tl - transportation line IDs; disabled by default

parameters.name: restrictionSource
parameters.description: The source of the restriction data to use.

parameters.name: snapDistance
parameters.description: The maximum distance in metres that a point can be from the road network and still be snapped to it.

parameters.name: simplifyDirections
parameters.description: If true, the directions are simplified to reduce the number of instructions.

parameters.name: simplifyThreshold
parameters.description: The maximum length in metres that a direction segment can be before it is split into multiple directions when simplifying.

parameters.name: listRestrictions
parameters.description: If true, the restriction identifiers satisfied by the route are listed in the response.

parameters.name: excludeRestrictions
parameters.description: A list of restriction identifiers to exclude from consideration.

parameters.name: minRoutingDistance
parameters.description: The minimum straight-line distance in metres between points on the same road segment below which routing is computed directly between the points rather than through the road network.

200.description: The route geometry, length, and travel time between the given points.
